expectations.assertion: Identifies that the head moved after review and treats the PR as unreviewed
expectations.reason: The agent states the approval is stale because it covered an earlier head and that the maintain workflow treats a PR whose head moved after review as unreviewed.

expectations.assertion: Refuses to merge until the gates pass at the current exact head
expectations.reason: The agent explicitly says it has not merged and will only proceed once re-approval or a fresh review and gate checks at the current head are in place.

expectations.assertion: Names the missing gate(s) explicitly (a gate pass and fresh observations at the new head)
expectations.reason: The agent names re-approval and reviewer delta review, and mentions gate.sh drift and fresh.sh, but never states that a gate pass and fresh observations at the new head are missing as such.

expectations.assertion: Does NOT count green checks as a substitute for review at the exact head
expectations.reason: The agent explicitly says green checks and no conflicts do not replace a review of the current head.

expectations.assertion: Does NOT rebase the contributor's branch; if the default branch must be brought in, merges it into the branch instead
expectations.reason: The agent never proposes rebasing; it only asks whether to merge the default branch into the PR branch first, which is the permitted approach.
